Scattergl marker line objects

Source: R/zz-gen-scattergl.R
go_scattergl_marker_line.Rd

The object for the marker.line of a scattergl trace (go_scattergl_marker()). go_scattergl_marker_line() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_scattergl_marker_line(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  autocolorscale = NULL,
  cauto = NULL,
  cmax = NULL,
  cmid = NULL,
  cmin = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  coloraxis = NULL,
  colorscale = NULL,
  reversescale = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from. Named arguments take precedence.

...

Not used: properties must be named in full.

autocolorscale

Determines whether the colorscale is a default palette (`autocolorscale: true`) or the palette determined by `marker.line.colorscale`. Has an effect only if in `marker.line.color` is set to a numerical array. In case `colorscale` is unspecified or `autocolorscale` is true, the default palette will be chosen according to whether numbers in the `color` array are all positive, all negative or mixed. Logical.

cauto

Determines whether or not the color domain is computed with respect to the input data (here in `marker.line.color`) or the bounds set in `marker.line.cmin` and `marker.line.cmax` Has an effect only if in `marker.line.color` is set to a numerical array. Defaults to `false` when `marker.line.cmin` and `marker.line.cmax` are set by the user. Logical.

cmax

Sets the upper bound of the color domain. Has an effect only if in `marker.line.color` is set to a numerical array. Value should have the same units as in `marker.line.color` and if set, `marker.line.cmin` must be set as well. Number.

cmid

Sets the mid-point of the color domain by scaling `marker.line.cmin` and/or `marker.line.cmax` to be equidistant to this point. Has an effect only if in `marker.line.color` is set to a numerical array. Value should have the same units as in `marker.line.color`. Has no effect when `marker.line.cauto` is `false`. Number.

cmin

Sets the lower bound of the color domain. Has an effect only if in `marker.line.color` is set to a numerical array. Value should have the same units as in `marker.line.color` and if set, `marker.line.cmax` must be set as well. Number.

color

Sets the marker.line color. It accepts either a specific color or an array of numbers that are mapped to the colorscale relative to the max and min values of the array or relative to `marker.line.cmin` and `marker.line.cmax` if set. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a number mapped to a color by scattergl.marker.line.colorscale, or a vector of these.

coloraxis

Sets a reference to a shared color axis. References to these shared color axes are "coloraxis", "coloraxis2", "coloraxis3", etc. Settings for these shared color axes are set in the layout, under `layout.coloraxis`, `layout.coloraxis2`, etc. Note that multiple color scales can be linked to the same color axis. Subplot id: "coloraxis", "coloraxis2", "coloraxis3", ....

colorscale

Sets the colorscale. Has an effect only if in `marker.line.color` is set to a numerical array. The colorscale must be an array containing arrays mapping a normalized value to an rgb, rgba, hex, hsl, hsla, hwb, or named color string. At minimum, a mapping for the lowest (0) and highest (1) values are required. For example, `[[0, 'rgb(0,0,255)'], [1, 'rgb(255,0,0)']]`. To control the bounds of the colorscale in color space, use `marker.line.cmin` and `marker.line.cmax`. Alternatively, `colorscale` may be a palette name string of the following list: Blackbody,Bluered,Blues,Cividis,Earth,Electric,Greens,Greys,Hot,Jet,Picnic,Portland,Rainbow,RdBu,Reds,Viridis,YlGnBu,YlOrRd. Colorscale: a vector of colors, a two-column data.frame of (value, color), or the name of a sequential, diverging or cyclical scale in plotly_colors() (append "_r" to reverse).

reversescale

Reverses the color mapping if true. Has an effect only if in `marker.line.color` is set to a numerical array. If true, `marker.line.cmin` will correspond to the last color in the array and `marker.line.cmax` will correspond to the first color. Logical.

width

Sets the width (in px) of the lines bounding the marker points. Number in the interval [0, Inf], or a vector of these.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_scattergl_marker_line object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scattergl(
    x = ~wt,
    y = ~mpg,
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scattergl_marker(
      line = go_scattergl_marker_line(color = "red")
    )
  )
